evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim rendering a technical reliability claim in plain, memorable opposition — the document's register signature crystallized in one line.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Is the speaker forging a maxim by casting a rule as two mirrored clauses whose opposition makes the point unanswerable?
